summary: Placement and layering are sound. The reusable workflow `.github/workflows/pr-status.yml` holds the plumbing. The live reads and writes sit in `scripts/pr-status.sh`, and the pure decision is in `scripts/pr-status-decide.sh`, which takes input only through env vars and has no I/O. The caller template is separate. Dependencies point one way: workflow, then I/O script, then decision script. Each test covers one layer, and the I/O test runs against a fake `gh`. There is no premature abstraction. The job checks out only this repo's two scripts at `job.workflow_sha`, never PR code, with minimal job permissions. Permission comes from the collaborators API, not `author_association`. Concurrency is per PR. Label writes use `GITHUB_TOKEN`, so they start no workflow. The only remark is the bash 4 dependency in the nit.

findings.note: `declare -A` needs bash 4+, so the script fails on a macOS runner (stock bash 3.2); the docs should say the minis must be Linux, which `deskmini` (Arch) is.
